reasons: UNSUPPORTED: "Die Produzenten gaben Heller eine beginnende Alzheimer-Erkrankung" (Gulf News says 'Heller's in the early stages of Alzheimer's' with no producers named. Delete 'Die Produzenten gaben'.)

Reviewer recommends rejection: Most claims check out. Reject for: (1) 'Die Produzenten gaben Heller eine beginnende Alzheimer-Erkrankung' has an invented attribution (Gulf News does not name producers). (2) The 1937 birth year cited to fernsehserien is not on the opened page, and the main page returned 404; unconfirmed. (3) McCabe & Mrs. Miller 1971 (Plex) conflicts with 1970 (fernsehserien) and the conflict is not disclosed. Also the prose is list-like and needs localising.

valueNote: Adds the disclosed birth-year conflict and the Emmy correction from TV Academy, and a sourced filmography. Still much of it is a list of roles from English press and databases, and the prose is stilted and list-like, which the style guide does not accept as localised German.
summary: Most claims check out. Reject for: (1) 'Die Produzenten gaben Heller eine beginnende Alzheimer-Erkrankung' has an invented attribution (Gulf News does not name producers). (2) The 1937 birth year cited to fernsehserien is not on the opened page, and the main page returned 404; unconfirmed. (3) McCabe & Mrs. Miller 1971 (Plex) conflicts with 1970 (fernsehserien) and the conflict is not disclosed. Also the prose is list-like and needs localising.
